settings.heading: Who is Mr Chocolate?
settings.row_content:
Mr Chocolate is a much-loved bear owned by our founder, Rebecca Mason.

Back in the late 1980s, when Rebecca and her now-husband Ian were dating, Ian took her to a Melbourne restaurant called Death by Chocolate. As a sweet gesture, he bought her a souvenir bear — who she named Mr Chocolate.

Mr Chocolate quickly became Rebecca’s favourite in her bear collection and soon earned his place as her loyal travel mascot. He’s been part of the journey ever since — and now represents the heart, nostalgia, and personal touch behind everything we do.

settings.heading: I’ve found a cheaper price online than what Mr Chocolate’s Travel has quoted. Why is that?
settings.row_content:
Before you decide, here are a few things to double-check:

🧸What currency is the online price in? Many international sites display prices in USD or EUR, which can appear cheaper until converted.

🧸Are there hidden costs? Taxes, resort fees, booking charges, or payment processing fees are often added at checkout — and they add up fast.

🧸Is it a reputable supplier? Some low-cost sites use offshore providers or don’t include support if things go wrong.

At Mr Chocolate’s Travel, we quote in AUD and include total pricing up front — no surprise fees. Plus, you get our expert support, curated planning, and human help if anything doesn’t go to plan. Peace of mind is part of the value.

If you’ve found a genuine lower price, let us know — we’re always happy to review it with you!

Send your lower comparison price to hello@mrchocolate.com.au

settings.heading: I noticed Mr Chocolate’s Travel charges an extra service fee to book flights. Why is that? I can easily book this myself online!
settings.row_content:
We totally understand this question — and we believe in being transparent.

Booking airfares is often the most intricate and time-consuming part of travel. Our service fee reflects the time, care, and expertise we dedicate to getting it right — and ensuring you’re supported every step of the way.

Here’s what our airfare service fee includes:

✈️ Sourcing and reserving the best fare based on your specific needs

✈️ Holding the best available options (same-day holds where possible)

✈️ Liaising with the airline on your behalf — saving you hours on hold

✈️ Managing seat requests, meals, and special services

✈️ Handling schedule changes or disruptions — we advocate for you

✈️ Co-ordinating with airlines on border/pass requirements where needed

✈️ Providing 24/7 support while you travel

✈️ Sharing personalised tips and suggestions for your destination

✈️ Supplying easy-to-access electronic documentation

We also have direct access to airline booking systems not available to the public, and can sometimes offer better value than what you’ll see online.

🧸And here’s something most people don’t realise: curating an airfare that fits your timing, connections, and preferences can be a detailed process — and it’s what we do best. While airlines focus on moving people from A to B, we focus on making the journey smoother — from seat selection to schedule changes and everything in between. Think of us as the helpful link between you and the airline — working behind the scenes to keep things seamless.

settings.heading: Can I book flights only?
settings.row_content: Yes — we offer standalone flight bookings. Our in-house airfare specialist ensures competitive pricing and carefully managed itineraries.

settings.heading: I put in an enquiry to Mr Chocolate's Travel over 1 week ago. Why haven't I heard from anyone?
settings.row_content:
Firstly, we’re so sorry if you’ve been waiting to hear back — that’s never our intention.

We pride ourselves on personalised service, which means we take time to thoughtfully respond to each enquiry. Occasionally, delays can happen during peak periods or if we’re waiting on supplier responses before getting back to you.

If it’s been more than a few business days, there’s a chance our reply may have landed in your junk or promotions folder, or your form submission didn’t come through as expected.

🧸If in doubt, feel free to follow up by email or phone — we’d love to help and don’t want to miss you!

settings.heading: Is Mr Chocolate’s Travel associated with Flight Centre, Helloworld, or another big travel chain?
settings.row_content:
No — we are a fully independent travel agency. Mr Chocolate’s Travel operates under the ATAC (Australian Travel Agents Co-operative), not a franchise or large retail chain.

This means we have access to excellent industry rates and support, while maintaining full control over our brand, service style, and client relationships. Our independence allows us to offer unbiased advice and personalised travel planning, tailored just for you.
